title: MCP Tools Registry (Bài #12)
description: Registry of MCP tools available to the workforce. v1.0 used 'role_required: string' (single-role). v1.1+ adds 'role_scope: string[]' (multi-role) + 'server', 'tier_default', 'tier_per_role' fields to align with the supabase-ops shim (mcp-server/) and the Phase 1 plan in .archives/plans/2026-05-16-mcp-ritsu-ops-integration/. Either shape is valid — a tool entry MUST have role_required OR role_scope (or `status: planned` for placeholders).

server.description: MCP server hosting this tool. Phase 1 servers: 'supabase-ops'.

role_required.description: v1.0 — single role string ('founder', 'any', etc.). For v1.1+ tools, prefer role_scope.

role_scope.description: v1.1+ — list of role slugs from governance/ROLES.md permitted to invoke this tool. Either role_required or role_scope must be present unless status='planned'.

tier_default.description: v1.1+ — default HITL tier required to invoke (per governance/HITL.md).

tier_per_role.description: v1.1+ — per-role override of tier_default. Useful when an autonomous role can take a tier that's notify-after for others.

hitl_required.description: v1.0 — boolean shortcut. v1.1+ tools should use tier_default/tier_per_role instead.

output_schema.description: Loose shape of the tool's output. Documentation, not enforced at runtime.

db_dependency.description: Optional: SQL function or table this tool relies on. Helps drift validators flag missing migrations.
